lucifer RAM estimate

Source: R/lucifer.RAM.R
lucifer.RAM.Rd

Estimates the random-access memory (RAM) required to update a given model and data with the lucifer function.

Usage

lucifer.RAM(Model, Data, Iterations, Thinning, Algorithm = "RWM")

Arguments

Model

A model specification function. See lucifer.

Data

A list of data. See lucifer.

Iterations

The number of iterations for which lucifer would update.

Thinning

The amount of thinning applied to the chains.

Algorithm

The name of the algorithm as a string, as entered in lucifer. Defaults to "RWM".

Value

A list with estimated RAM (in MB) for each component: Covar, Data, Deviance, Initial.Values, Model, Monitor, post, Posterior1, Posterior2, Summary1, Summary2, and Total.

Details

The lucifer.RAM function uses object.size to estimate the size in MB of RAM required to update one chain in lucifer for a given model and data. When RAM is exceeded, the computer will crash. This function is useful when estimating how many iterations to update without crashing.

See also

BigData, lucifer, LML, object.size
